negative.meaning: direction flag returned by Elo.ratingChange for one party
negative.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

rating_change_obtained.meaning: whether battleElo obtained a rating change amount change and direction flag negative from Elo.ratingChange for one party after a single battle
rating_change_obtained.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

elob_should_decrease.meaning: whether negative being true signifies eloB's rating should decrease
elob_should_decrease.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

elob_should_increase.meaning: whether negative being false signifies eloB's rating should increase
elob_should_increase.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

elo_b_direction_correct.meaning: whether eloB's applied rating change direction matches the direction signified by negative (decrease when negative true, increase when negative false)
elo_b_direction_correct.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative to eloB

dependent_uses_incorrect_data.meaning: whether protocol functionality relying on the Elo ratings operates on data inconsistent with the direction signified by negative
dependent_uses_incorrect_data.checkpoint: when dependent protocol functionality consumes the computed Elo ratings

assumptions: Elo.ratingChange(eloB, eloA, ...) computes the adjustment for eloB relative to eloA, with negative true meaning eloB should decrease.
The scenario is described conditionally; no concrete battle, actor, or observed on-chain values are supplied.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the negative true or negative false branch was actually executed in a real battle; the plan formalizes the negative-true branch as the representative case.

limitations: Only the negative-true branch is encoded in the condition; the negative-false branch is symmetric and not separately formalized.
Downstream harms (rankings, matchmaking, rewards) are conditional on dependent functionality and are not formalized here.
No concrete numeric change amount or rating values are supplied; the relation is qualitative direction correspondence.
